name: character-card
title: Character Card
description: A character sheet in a case: a portrait panel (toned as a screentone, or the initials on paper), the name in lettering, the role, stats as bars filled with speed lines, tags (kit Badge) and a short quote in a small speech bubble. Static by default; interactive adds the hover lift and the ink focus ring.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/character-card". The portrait goes through TonedImage; the tags use the kit Badge (outline) and the quote a SpeechBubble.

meta.tagline: A character sheet: portrait, stats in bars, a quote.
meta.usage:
import { CharacterCard } from "@/components/manga/character-card"

<CharacterCard
  name="Kai Mori"
  role="Courier"
  image="/kai.jpg"
  stats={[{ label: "Power", value: 82 }, { label: "Speed", value: 6, max: 10 }]}
  tags={["Rooftops"]}
  quote="The bridge is closed."
  interactive
/>

props.name: role
props.description: Title or occupation, under the name.

props.name: image
props.description: Portrait URL, toned. Without it, the initials stand on paper.

props.name: toned
props.description: Tone the portrait. Pass false for art that is already inked.

props.name: stats
props.type: { label: string; value: number; max?: number }[]
props.description: Bars filled with speed lines. max defaults to 100.

props.name: quote
props.description: A line in a small speech bubble.

props.name: className
props.description: Added to the card, e.g. its width.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Hover lift and focus ring; the card takes focus.
